Chapter 500 Rumors and Holy Land Dreams (Page 1)
Rumors and Holy Land Dreams (Rumors and Holy Land Dreams (Page 22) "Then why doesn't the Holy See speak?!" Yes, why doesn't the Holy See speak? This abnormal silence is more frightening than any doomsday prophecy. The shallow believers just feel that the world is about to change, and they quickly stock up on a few more bags of flour to watch the fun. But those devout believers, their worldview has directly collapsed. They knelt on their knees in front of the closed doors of churches everywhere, crying. They shouted and begged the priest to open the door and give them some perfunctory words of comfort, but the door was always tightly closed. Unlike the heated public opinion outside, the atmosphere inside the Holy See fell into a strange and suffocating silence. The root of all this was not that the higher-ups deliberately pretended to be deaf, but because of that night - before the dazzling "Venus" fell. Inside the Holy Land, Avalon was filled with red. Archbishop Yi, down to the children's choir in charge of cleaning, everyone had an almost identical dream. In that vague but grand picture, a majestic golden figure stood in the void, and the light around it was dimming at a speed visible to the naked eye. The figure seemed to be telling the world something vaguely. The farther the priest went on the Shinto and the higher the realm, the only words he heard in that dream. The phrases became clearer. "Running towards the end..." "The seal... must not be broken..." "I will no longer accompany you in the long night..." Huge panic spread among the clergy like a plague. At dawn, the morning bell had not yet sounded. Several powerful core archbishops rushed to the Holy See with disheveled hair and asked to see the Pope. The Pope is the strongest person in the entire Holy Religion. The person closest to God in the world. The bishops expected to get a refutation from this spiritual pillar, even if it was a lie. However, when the Pope looked at them with a deathly expression, everyone's heart suddenly fell into the ice. The most powerful man in the Holy Religion just closed his eyes and announced a fact that made them almost crazy. As for the God of Light, he has fallen. What the more detailed oracle was given to him, the Pope did not immediately say. He only issued the highest level of death order: all churches should stop all external interpretations, and he himself would explain the final will of God to the entire continent in seven days. The crowd dispersed like zombies, and the entire Holy See was completely shut down. It was impossible to completely cover up the turmoil on this scale. Soon, the news that "the Pope will break his silence and give a speech" spread like wings across the mountains and rivers. The fear and undercurrent of the outside world seemed to be completely isolated from this luxurious palace. The afternoon sun shone through the glazed windows, making the interior peaceful and cozy. Sitting on a soft velvet chair, she was holding a copy of the "Wangdu Morning News" with bold black characters on the front page. She glanced at the fanatical speculation about the current situation of the Holy See and put the newspaper aside on the mahogany wood. On the round table, he picked up the exquisite bone china tea cup and blew in the hot air. "He is indeed the 'King of Souls' and 'Lord of Dreams' of the past..." Serviya took a sip and sighed.
